desc: The C-CDA on FHIR Implementation Guide is a US Realm Implementation Guide of the FHIR Specification addressing the key aspects of Consolidated CDA (C-CDA) required for Meaningful Use (MU). This IG publication release focuses on providing data mappings for C-CDA Documents and USCDI-3.
